limits: No new training, selected checkpoints, alternative seeds, native retries or cap extensions
B bundles normalization and numerical tie handling; does not isolate those separately
C is an information-seeking tie heuristic, not optimal information gain or a new memory architecture
64 paired layout draws, not 3840 independent decks; actual trajectories may diverge
This follow-up tests the controller; novelty and broader architectural efficacy remain unestablished
order: Controller order delta, gated_delta, kalman, innovation_local, innovation_matched, gru each pair 0, 1, 2, then exact,last32; within each controller, case 0..63 then explicit rotating policy_order

policy_definitions.A: Exact original PublicCardTracker choice and public overrides; no normalization or tolerance
policy_definitions.B: Float64 raw-row normalization, original public overrides, inclusive 1e-12 band from maximum score; lexicographic first pair endpoint or smallest second-card index
policy_definitions.C: Same B scores and tie set; on first card choose smallest unseen endpoint among tied pairs if any, otherwise B; second choice exactly B

sizing.output_cap_includes: all files in exclusive output directory, before closure and after final receipt
sizing.wall_cap_includes: authentication, all resets/layout hashes/decisions/model reads and writes/native steps, serialization and final hash checks
